name: non-json-prose

input.modelOutput: I will open Settings and tap the Wi-Fi row.

note: observed: the prose contains no '{'/'}' pair, so extractJsonObject throws 'Model response did not contain a JSON object.', which parseActionCandidate's catch replaces with 'Model response did not contain valid action JSON.'. The assertion matches the message the caller actually sees; it pins a rejection, never an action shape.
